points.point: Is there a 100 MB Google Drive limit?
points.sentence: Blotato does not impose a 100 MB Google Drive cutoff.

points.point: Drive warning page instead of the file
points.sentence: Google Drive sometimes returns a warning page instead of the file for large videos.

points.point: How to fix it for the 350 MB video
points.sentence: First, share the file as "Anyone with the link" and use https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=FILE_ID&export=download&confirm=t.
Check your Blotato plan limit and the destination platform's media limit separately.

verdict.reason: This entry says there is no 100 MB Drive cutoff, explains the warning page, gives the link fix, and says plan limits apply separately.
